method.simulation: Machado, Oliveira and Fernandes (2009), published matrices at severities 10 through 100 in steps of 10, plus normal vision
method.pipeline: sRGB -> linear RGB -> simulation -> clip to display gamut -> CIELAB D65 -> CIEDE2000, unit parametric factors
method.scope: Five chromatic syntax roles, ten pairs, 31 scenarios, two variants: 620 pair/scenario comparisons per palette version. This is a design regression check, not accessibility certification.
method.baseline: tests/fixtures/palette-v1.json, published before this revision at d0e2256eeb1ae88d43e32647dd171fc0d4a1921f
